main.description: A parameterized text template with named variable slots. Generalizes bead's Template (text pattern with {slotName} placeholders, slot definitions, and cross-slot constraints) and similar pattern structures used for stimulus generation, item construction, data augmentation, and controlled natural language. Templates are composable: they can reference ontologies, collections, and other templates.

slots.description: The named slots in this template.

constraints.description: Cross-slot constraints (e.g., agreement, semantic compatibility). These apply across multiple slots in this template.

ontologyRef.description: Reference to the ontology defining the type system used by this template.

experimentRef.description: Reference to the experiment this template was designed for.

knowledgeRefs.description: Knowledge graph groundings for this template (e.g., a construction, a linguistic phenomenon, a stimulus paradigm).

metadata.description: Provenance: who designed this template, with what tool.

features.description: Open-ended features: measureType, taskType, category, domain, etc.

createdAt.description: When this template record was created.

languages.description: BCP-47 language tags this record covers. Empty when language is unspecified or unknown.

languageRefs.description: Structured language references (canonical BCP-47 tag plus optional script, region, variety, and role) grounding the languages this record covers.
